description: Labeled reference set for the ralphy ref digest contact-sheet quality/cost eval. Videos are referenced by path relative to .ralphy/workspaces/ on the maintainer machine (read-only; not shipped). Labels only; no media.
grid: textGrid[k] and classGrid[k] describe the frame at t = k + 0.5 s

questions.ask: List every shot boundary as a timestamp in seconds: a change to a different shot, scene, slide, or camera setup, whether a hard cut or an animated transition (use the transition midpoint). Do not count caption or text changes, flashes, or zooms inside the same continuous shot.

Which transition types occur at those boundaries: hard_cut; dissolve_fade (crossfade, fade through black or white, a flash between two different shots); motion (slide, push, wipe, swipe, whip, zoom transition). Empty list when there are no shot boundaries.
Time intervals during which any on-screen text is visible: captions, subtitles, titles, labels, or UI text legible as words. Ignore tiny watermarks and logos.

Classify the video over time with change points: talking_head (a person on screen speaking to camera, or a visible interview speaker, including split screen with a visible speaker); b_roll (footage without a visible speaking person: scenes, people acting, products, environments, generated cinematic shots); graphics (screen recordings, UI, slides, text cards, motion graphics, static image collages).

For the first 2 seconds (0 <= t <= 2): is a human or humanlike face clearly visible; is any on-screen text visible; is there a shot boundary at 0 < t < 2; the opening class (talking_head | b_roll | graphics) at the start; and transcribe the on-screen text visible in the first 2 seconds (null when none).

Is there an explicit call to action (on-screen text, end card, or caption asking the viewer to act: follow, comment, answer a question, visit, buy, download, DM, save, sign up)? If yes, the time it first appears.
